notes.title: Hit, Stand… Save! Credits & UI Update
notes.notes: [p][b]✉️ Greetings from Norrland – The Land of the Midnight Sun[/b][/p][p]Greetings from Norrland in Sweden — the land of the midnight sun! ☀️  [/p][p]Up here it's basically 24 hours of sunshine a day*, so what better time to stay indoors and update a blackjack game? 😉[/p][p](*Well... close enough.)[/p][p][/p][p][b]🛠️ What’s New in This Patch[/b][/p][p]Here’s what’s been updated in the latest build:[/p][p][/p][p][b]🎵 More Music[/b][/p][p]• More background music tracks added — let the cards fall to the beat of the music.[/p][p][/p][p][b]🌍 New Font with Expanded Language Support[/b][/p][p]• The in-game font has been changed to better support [i]many more Latin-based languages[/i].  [/p][p]• This improves UI consistency and prepares for future translations.[/p][p][/p][p][b]🎨 UI Improvements[/b] [/p][p]• Button positions adjusted  [/p][p]• Text windows refined for readability[/p][p][/p][p][b]💾 Credits Now Save Between Sessions[/b][/p][p]• This was a [i]requested feature by players[/i] — thank you!  [/p][p]• Your credits will now [i]persist[/i] when quitting and restarting the game.  [/p][p]• You can still press [b]“New Game”[/b] to start over with 100 credits.[/p][p][/p][p][b]💀 Hard Mode – No More Auto Hand Counting[/b][/p][p]• In [b]Hard difficulty[/b], the card counter is now [b]hidden[/b]!  [/p][p]• You’ll have to keep track of your total manually — just like at a real blackjack table.  [/p][p]• Good luck… and maybe bring a calculator. 😉[/p][p][/p][p][b]🌐 New Languages Added[/b][/p][p]We’ve started expanding support for more Latin-alphabet languages.
